summary: Organise sensor metadata, quality checks, and data lineage with practical IoT exercises. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: IoT data management helps data stewards, platform operators and asset engineers turn connected-device telemetry into traceable, usable records. The training covers mapping MQTT and OPC UA flows, defining device and observation metadata, and checking sensor data quality in Excel. You also practise documenting data lineage and creating retention, access and exception controls to support review of sensor-derived decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle connected-device data from acquisition through reporting, including technical practitioners, data owners, and operational decision-makers.
audience: Asset Performance Analysts using sensor records
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace data handling and the operational process that generates sensor data is expected. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; no add-ins or separate platform account are needed. The exercises use course sample sensor records and working sheets. MQTT data flows, edge processing, and time-series storage are treated at an introductory operational-design level.
